root: ^Good morning! You must be Chemy, the new alchemist!
^I'm Poshe! I deliver the newspaper every morning.
^Thank you, Poshe. You're up pretty early.
^Hehe, I have to be! Everyone wants to know what's happening around town.
^Yep! Besides the daily news, it also lists requests from the townspeople.
^Whenever someone needs an alchemist's help, they post their request there.
^You can pick whichever requests you'd like to complete.
^It is! Just don't let the requests pile up, or everyone will start complaining.
^Well, I still have more newspapers to deliver.
^Hmm... there are two requests looking for an alchemist.
^I should help them while I have the chance.
^Time to gather the ingredients and get to work.
